newsitem.title: MEXICO: Foreign firms to invest $7.18 bln in Mexico in '97.
newsitem.headline: Foreign firms to invest $7.18 bln in Mexico in '97.

text.p: A group of 100 foreign firms with subsidiaries operating in Mexico pledged Wednesday to invest directly a total of $7.18 billion in the nation during 1997, Trade Minister Herminio Blanco said.
"During 1997, firms backed by foreign capital represented here plan to invest $7.18 billion," Blanco said at a meeting of businessmen and President Ernesto Zedillo.
Blanco said that last year the same group of companies, Carrefour Supermarche SA and International Business Machines Corp, invested $6.3 billion in Mexico.
Blanco said the total direct foreign investment in Mexico in 1996 was around $9 billion, a similar figure to that recorded in 1995.
The foreign firm investments this year come on top of the $7 billion pledge made Tuesday by 31 Mexican firms.
